chunks: Those who disbelieve will say: 'O Lord, show us those among the jinns and men who had led us astray that we may trample them underfoot and make them wholly abject.'
ai.seo_question: Who do the disbelievers ask God to show them on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological shift of disbelievers from arrogance to regret, specifically identifying both jinn and humans as co-agents of misguidance. The desire to 'trample' them signifies a final, futile attempt to externalize blame, yet it confirms their own complicity in the hierarchy of Hell. This reflects the principle that leaders of misguidance are held accountable alongside their followers, as seen in the concept of 'qadwa' (precedent) in moral responsibility.
